name: Vitus
title: Grand Master

villagemaster/32213.htm.text: Grand Master Vitus: Welcome. I am Grand Master Vitus of the Kamael Guild here in the Town of Giran. If you have questions about class transfer, you have come to the right place.

links.text: Listen to information about second class transfer.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/32213-01.htm.text: Grand Master Vitus: What prompted you to come here? Do you need help? Just say the word and I will do whatever I can.

links.text: I would like to become a Soul Breaker.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/32213-03.htm.text: Grand Master Vitus: Why have you come here? You seem too weak to walk the same path we do. Perhaps one day when you are stronger... (This quest is for characters level 39 and above who have completed the 1st class transfer.)

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/32213-02.htm.text: Grand Master Vitus: Why have you come to see me? Please move on if you do not need my assistance. I am very busy right now! (This quest is only available for Kamael.)

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/32213-07.htm.text: Grand Master Vitus: You must gain Hierarch Kekropus's approval of your qualifications. Seek him out and he will give you further instructions.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/32213-08.htm.text: Grand Master Vitus: You must first prove your qualifications. Come back to me when you have done so.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/32213-10.htm.text: Grand Master Vitus: Since the Hierarch has given you his approval, there is nothing else to say. Welcome to the world of the Soul Breakers. Bear this mark and you will be welcomed by the other grand masters. I look forward to meeting you again.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/32213-04.htm.text: Grand Master Vitus: Soul Breaker... That is not an easy path. But I see that your will is strong. I respect your intention, and I will consider granting your request if you can prove your ability. Will you consent to be tested?

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/32213-05.htm.text: Grand Master Vitus: Good! Then go to Hierarch Kekropus and obtain his recognition of your qualifications. You can have no better ally in your quest than his approval. He will give you the details of the test. Take this Dimension Diamond; it will prove useful to you during your test. Use it well.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/32213-06.htm.text: Grand Master Vitus: Good! Then go to Hierarch Kekropus and obtain his recognition of your qualifications. You can have no better ally in your quest than his approval. He will give you the details of the test.

Q00065_CertifiedSoulBreaker/32213-09.htm.text: Grand Master Vitus: Since the Hierarch has given you his approval, there is nothing else to say. Welcome to the world of the Soul Breakers. Bear this mark and you will be welcomed by the other grand masters. And take this Dimension Diamond; it will be useful to you on your journeys. Use it well!
